references.context: On each plunge, aim for the center top lane.
references.label: Center top lane
references.description: The center rollover is between the two outer top lanes.

references.context: Repeat either spinner to send the ball through the top lanes until the 40,000 Super Bonus is lit.
references.label: Left spinner
references.description: The left spinner is above the KISS drop bank.

references.context: Repeat either spinner to send the ball through the top lanes until the 40,000 Super Bonus is lit.
references.label: Right spinner
references.description: The right spinner is above the A-B-C-D targets.

references.context: After the 40,000 Super Bonus is lit, complete A-B-C-D on the right for 2X Bonus.
references.label: A-B-C-D targets
references.description: The A-B-C-D targets are on the right-middle playfield.

references.context: Top-lane K-I-S-S letters complete rows toward the 40,000 Super Bonus.
references.label: KISS bonus grid
references.description: The four-row KISS grid is in the center of the playfield.
